correctness.rationale: PASS: The finite simple prism C_n square K_2 and natural commuting layer swap are precisely defined for all n≥3; the action preserves independent faces. Oriented setwise-fixed faces contribute (-1)^(cycles−1), including the empty simplex, so reduced Lefschetz is minus the signed fixed orbit-set polynomial. The 3-state transfer T has exact characteristic polynomial (z−1)(z²+1), giving cyclic Q_m=1+2cos(mπ/2); the open transfer P_m=(-1)^floor((m+1)/2) follows from its T² action. Rotation orbit quotient has gcd(n,j) columns (self-conflicting when 1); reflections fold to path length (n−1)/2 for odd n and n/2+1 for even n, with the opposite odd-axis orbit self-conflicting; the rung layer-swap fixes only empty face. Their traces are −Q_gcd, −P_path, and −1. Agarwal--Basak Theorem 15, read directly in complete arXiv HTML, proves homology only in stated degree with rank one or three. Multiplying reduced Lefschetz by (−1)^degree yields generator traces; semisimple rational finite-group representations and group relations force the claimed matrices. For 4k, rotation traces give 1⊕Q(i), reflection has zero trace on Q(i) and stated line sign, while commuting swap is +I on Q(i) and −1 on the line. For n odd and n≡2 mod4, the one-dimensional generator signs follow. Independent exact fixed-face enumeration checked all 208 group elements at n=3..10 without running package code, and independently verified the transfer spectrum and 24 Q/P values; source-tree Git hash reconstructed exactly. All-n scope is analytic and relies on the cited independently read nonequivariant classification.
